data.title: Feeling the Heat: Chicago Fire at Atlanta United Preview
data.content:
Some departure from the normal XI is inevitable: Jack Elliott, normally the team's captain and a set-in-stone starter, is serving the second of a two game suspension, paving the way for Andreas Hanche-Olsen's second consecutive MLS start, but the question is how much departure from the norm we may see in a game that feels like a very winnable must-win match for the Fire. [...] The Fire should have full confidence that they'll be able to walk away with three points, but margins in MLS are thin, and underestimating opponents is exactly how trap games happen.
